title: PLL Testbench
text: Validate PLL system by measuring operating frequency, lock time, and phase noise, 1 input, 1 output; {Set stop time} sets the recommended minimum simulation stop time as model stop time, {Plot phase noise profile}, {Export measurement results}, {Amplitude (V)} sets the maximum value of stimulus signal at PLL, {Frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of stimulus signal at PLL input, {Add phase noise}, {Phase noise frequency offset (Hz)} sets the frequency offsets of phase noise from carrier frequency, {Phase noise level (dBc/Hz)} sets the phase noise power at specified frequency offsets relative to the carrier, {Estimate phase noise parameters} sets the automatically estimate phase noise, {Period jitter (S)} sets the standard deviation of period jitter, {Flicker corner frequency (Hz)} sets the corner frequency of flicker noise, {Plot fit} plots specified and expected output phase noise density, {Frequency of operation} sets the measure operating frequency of PLL DUT, {Lock time} sets the measure locking time of PLL DUT, {Target frequency of operation (Hz)} sets the target operating frequency of PLL DUT to calculate lock time, {Error tolerance (Hz)} sets the error tolerance for lock time measurement, {Phase noise} sets the measure phase noise level of PLL DUT, {Resolution bandwidth (Hz)} sets the smallest positive frequency that can be resolved, {No. of spectral averages} sets the number of spectral averages, {Hold off time (s)} sets the delays measurement analysis to avoid, {Frequency offset vector (Hz)} sets the frequency points relative to fundamental frequency where phase noise is calculated, {Lock time (s)} sets the maximum time in which PLL DUT needs to get locked and {Phase noise (dBc/Hz)} sets the target noise power corresponding to frequency offset vector. Values come from the instance.
